Method of Attack: Fake installers distributed via deceptive Google Ads installing malware
Impacted Systems: Users of legitimate software targeted by fake download sites
Attack Vector: Google Ads used to promote phishing and fake download sites
Indicators of Compromise: Fake download sites for Grammarly, MSI Afterburner, Slack, Dashlane, Malwarebytes, Audacity, μTorrent, OBS, Ring, AnyDesk, Libre Office, Teamviewer, Thunderbird, Brave
